components.name: Button
components.description: Default pill action on a clean sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 500 1rem/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font: 500 1rem/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--background); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Mono tag for status and metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.15rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 0.75rem/1.5 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: var(--sunk); color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-chip--good { background: var(--good-soft); color: var(--good); border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Nav Links
components.description: Pill links in the top bar; current page in sea mist.
components.html: How it worksRoadmapSpec
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.5rem; background: var(--background); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-nav__link { padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font: 500 0.875rem var(--font-body); } .ds-nav__link:hover { background: var(--sunk); } .ds-nav__link[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Pill
components.description: Opens the search dialog; shows the shortcut.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; width: 22rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.5rem 0 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.875rem/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-search:hover { border-color: var(--soft); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search__text { flex: 1; text-align: left; } .ds-kbd { min-width: 1.4em; padding: 0 0.35em; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); font: 500 0.6875rem/1.6 var(--font-mono); }

narrative.overview:
Bearing's surfaces read like a well-kept reference: a plain question, a direct answer, and the citation right beside it. The page is cool paper tinted toward the brand's deep sea teal; ink is near-black with the same lean, so every grey looks deliberate next to the mark. Decoration earns its place only when it carries information: a status colour on a verdict, a dashed line for a footstep, a mono label naming where something came from.

Density is calm. Running text keeps a reading measure (46rem), headings in Bricolage Grotesque are rare and confident, and IBM Plex carries everything else. Mono is the voice of provenance: times, file names, sources, labels and code. Controls are precise and unhurried: pills and small radii, hairline rules, quick ease-out transitions, nothing that shouts.

The system follows the reader's light or dark setting everywhere, as the logo and diagrams do. Depth is softly layered: tonal steps between background, surface and sunk do most of the work, hairline rules separate, and gentle ambient shadows lift what floats.
keyCharacteristics: Cool, teal-leaning neutrals; one accent, used sparingly.
Status colours (good, warn, bad) only for state, never as decoration.
Mono for provenance and labels; display type only for titles and headings.
Pills for actions, small radii for data, larger radii for figures and dialogs.
Light and dark from one token set via `prefers-color-scheme`.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only brand colour. It marks what you can act on or where you are; it is never a fill for large areas.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red mean a state (found, partial, dead end, accepted, proposed). Never use them for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Mark Is Fixed Rule
rules.body: Use the SVGs in `docs/brand/`; never recolour the ink parts in the accent, rotate the mark, or add outlines, shadows or gradients. Never below 16px.

rules.name: The Sparing Display Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque is for the wordmark, page titles and section headings only. Never for body, buttons or labels.

rules.name: The Mono Means Source Rule
rules.body: Times, file paths, sources, counts and labels are mono with tabular numerals; prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow is never the only edge: pair it with a hairline rule, keep it at or below the menu lift on cards, and never stack shadows.

dos: Do take every colour and font from the tokens in `site/static/css/tokens.css`, which mirror `docs/brand/README.md`; change the brand file first.
Do show where an answer came from, in mono, next to the answer.
Do keep running text to the 46rem measure and leave tables and code the full column.
Do design light and dark together; check both.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; keep transitions at 120–420ms with the ease-out curve.
Do keep a visible 2px teal focus ring offset 2px.
donts: Don't use green, amber or red for anything but state.
Don't set body, buttons or labels in Bricolage Grotesque.
Don't redraw, recolour, rotate or decorate the mark, or show it under 16px.
Don't use the animated mark as a loading spinner or more than once per page.
Don't fill large areas with the accent.
Don't rely on a shadow alone for an edge, or stack shadows.
